refutation_explanation: Every vertex initially has degree at least 2 (degrees 3,2,2,3,2,2). Removing 1 < 2 edges leaves degrees 2,2,2,2,2,2, so no vertex is isolated, but it separates {0,1,2} from {3,4,5}; therefore the remaining graph is disconnected.
search_space: All 9 labeled simple undirected graphs formed by triangles on {0,1,2} and {3,4,5} plus one edge between the triangles, with k=2; for each graph, all 8 edge-removal sets of size 0 or 1 were checked (72 graph/removal pairs total).
